instruction: A warehouse starts with 2162 boxes. Then the stock is doubled by merging with a sister warehouse. It receives 3 deliveries of 25 boxes each. It ships 13 boxes per day for 3 days. Then the stock is split equally into 3 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). It receives 2 deliveries of 33 boxes each. Then the stock is split equally into 3 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). Then the stock is split equally into 2 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). Then the stock is doubled by merging with a sister warehouse. It ships 11 boxes per day for 4 days. Then the stock is split equally into 3 warehouses and it keeps one share (rounded down). It receives 3 deliveries of 52 boxes each. Then the stock is doubled by merging with a sister warehouse. How many boxes does it have at the end? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. For this instance, let q denote the integer quantity requested above. Report q + 84754 instead of q. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
